response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong web/full-stack and some systems-level background, but he does not meet the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience (only ~7 months at National Instruments plus a thesis project). His large-scale infrastructure exposure (low-latency DLang microservices at Dunnhumby) is relevant but limited, and his career centers on TypeScript/Node.js product work rather than cloud compute platforms. Formal technical leadership of teams and platform strategy is also not evidenced.
strengths: Experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, and open-source contributions
Demonstrated mentoring inclination via workshops, courses, and code katas
concerns: Far short of the required 8 years of C++ experience (~7 months professional)
Little evidence of production cloud architecture or compute platform ownership
No formal technical-leadership role managing priorities, alignment, or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers
